For this patient's hypertension: date of the most recent blood pressure, days since then, and the home medications for that condition.
Context: patient MRN SYN-cdedf8570c (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2025-09-13, treated as today.

This is read-only: do not change the chart.

Change nothing else in the chart.

Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order.
